title: Self-Discover: Large Language Models Self-Compose Reasoning Structures
summary: Introduces the SELF‑DISCOVER framework allowing LLMs to autonomously construct reasoning structures from atomic modules, improving complex task performance and reducing inference steps.

title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Without Prompting
summary: Proposes a decoding strategy (CoT decoding) that elicits natural chain‑of‑thought paths during generation without explicit prompting, boosting reasoning benchmark scores.

title: ReFT: Representation Finetuning for Language Models
summary: Presents Representation Finetuning (ReFT), a parameter‑efficient method that modifies hidden representations via low‑rank projection, achieving comparable performance to full fine‑tuning with far fewer parameters.

title: What matters when building vision‑language models?
summary: A systematic study identifying critical design choices for VLMs, showing that backbone quality and data scaling dominate performance over architectural tweaks.

title: ShareGPT4Video: Improving Video Understanding and Generation with Better Captions
summary: Introduces a 40k‑sample video caption dataset annotated by GPT‑4V and a corresponding VLM that achieves state‑of‑the‑art results on video QA and generation.

title: Depth Anything V2
summary: Enhances monocular depth estimation by training on massive synthetic data and pseudo‑labeled real images, delivering >10× speedup and higher accuracy than prior methods.

title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next‑Scale Prediction
summary: Reframes image generation as a coarse‑to‑fine next‑scale prediction task, enabling autoregressive transformers to surpass diffusion models in quality and inference speed.

title: Megalodon: Efficient LLM Pretraining and Inference with Unlimited Context Length
summary: Presents the Megalodon architecture featuring complex exponential moving average and normalized attention, allowing trillion‑token context handling with superior efficiency.

title: SaulLM-54B & SaulLM-141B: Scaling Up Domain Adaptation for the Legal Domain
summary: Describes two Mixtral‑based LLMs pretrained on >540 B legal tokens, achieving state‑of‑the‑art performance on legal benchmarks while remaining open‑source.

title: Vision‑Language Model FRAMES
summary: A Retrieval‑Augmented Generation evaluation set with 824 multi‑hop questions, designed to benchmark reasoning and temporal understanding in VLMs.
